claims.sourceText: Marcel Jr. affidavit for the Fund for UFO Research; Disclosure Project testimony, 9 May 2001; 'The Roswell Legacy' (2009)
claims.text: Marcel Jr. testified under oath by affidavit and repeatedly on the record that in July 1947 his father showed him debris including foil-like metal that resumed its shape and an I-beam bearing embossed purple-violet symbols.
